keyVerseText: That our garners may be full, affording all manner of store : that our sheep may bring forth thousands and ten thousands in our streets: all: Heb. from kind to kind
rootMeaning: The root word אֶלֶף (ʼeleph) fundamentally means 'thousand' and is linked to the image of an ox's head, which was the first letter of the Hebrew alphabet and eventually came to signify the numeral one thousand. From this root, the verb אָלַף (ʼâlaph) emerges as a denominative form, meaning 'to bring forth thousands' or 'to make thousandfold.' This root sense conveys not just a quantity but also the idea of multiplication and abundant increase, going beyond the simple English understanding of 'thousand' to include the dynamic action of producing or causing to multiply greatly.
usageInScripture: The word אָלַף appears with the meaning 'may bring forth thousands' in its single recorded occurrence, emphasizing a causative or productive action that results in great multiplication. Its translation consistently reflects this sense of abundance or exponential increase, whether referring to people or livestock, as it carries both verbal and nominal nuances. This consistency highlights the word's thematic focus on divine blessing and fruitful increase, which is central to its biblical usage.
theologicalSignificance: Understanding אָלַף as 'to bring forth thousands' enriches our grasp of God's providential power to multiply and bless beyond measure. It reveals a divine capacity not only to create but to cause growth and fruitfulness in His people and their endeavors. This multiplication is not merely numerical but signifies God's covenant faithfulness and the fulfillment of His promises to make His people numerous and prosperous. For the Christian faith, this word points to the abundant life and blessings found in Christ, who enables spiritual fruitfulness and growth in the kingdom of God.
keyVerseReflection: In Psalms 144:13, the phrase 'that our sheep may bring forth thousands and ten thousands in our streets' uses אָלַף to express a prayer for abundant increase and provision. This word emphasizes the hope that God's blessing will cause multiplication and prosperity in the community's livestock, symbolizing overall flourishing. The use of אָלַף here conveys a confident expectation that God's favor results in exponential growth, reflecting His sustaining and multiplying power in the lives of His people.
